items.q: And when it wasn't him, I was out with Pee Wee Crayton. We'd take the same band out with him..

ctx.x: Yeah. And I'd go with him. And when it wasn't him, I was out with Pee Wee Crayton. We'd take the same band out with him.. Then Roy Hawkins. I'd take the same band. And with the other boy, Jimmy... I went out with Jimmy Witherspoon one time. Then I went out with another boy who came in named Jimmy.
